data.long_description:
One of A kind Duplex Penthouse with a third floor rooftop huge terrace, completely renovated with the best views of the sunset and the City 

Luxurious Fully Furnished Property with Stunning Features

This exceptional property offers a blend of luxury, comfort, and breathtaking views. Designed with meticulous attention to detail, it boasts custom-made furniture, high-end finishes, and an array of premium amenities. Here's everything you need to know about this stunning home:

--

Unmatched Views:
Enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view that captures the beauty of:
- The iconic Burj Khalifa
- The mesmerizing Dubai Fountain
- The charming Old Town
- The serene Business Bay Canal
- Jumeirah and Za’abeel

--

Outdoor Paradise:
The property features multiple balconies and a huge rooftop terrace  that’s perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Highlights include:
- A fully equipped bar
- A stylish lounge area
- A luxurious jacuzzi
- A guest bathroom
- A beautifully designed outdoor garden ambiance

--

Elegant Interior Spaces

Bedrooms and Bathrooms
- Two luxurious bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, offering privacy and comfort.
- A third room on the ground floor with an ensuite bathroom, ideal as a guest room or maid’s room.

Walk-in Closet and Sauna
- A full-room walk-in closet that includes a private sauna and an additional bathroom, combining functionality with indulgence.

--

Modern Conveniences
- A private elevator for seamless access across floors.
- High-end appliances from Miele, ensuring top-notch quality and performance.

--

This property is a masterpiece of design and luxury, offering an unparalleled living experience. Whether you’re hosting guests or enjoying peaceful moments, this home has everything you need to live in style.
